measure.grain: one anonymous four-year-university observation per course type
measure.scope: all degree- and college-level BSCS course requirements; general education excluded
measure.weighting: each university observation weighted equally within its course type
measure.categories: four-year course code; discrete mathematics always counted as math

reconstruction.method: The deposited requirement workbook was reviewed at its underlying requirement/equivalency rows. For each four-year university and course type, the numerator is articulated Figure 1 named-course observations and the denominator is all Figure 1 named-course observations of that type. Degree- and college-level requirements are included; general education and free-elective padding are excluded. Results are recorded at the final figure's nearest-whole-percentage-point precision.
reconstruction.identity_limit: The committed values are sorted category multisets. They preserve the direct raw-data rerun without assigning campus identities to the final PDF's unlabeled dots. Cross-source reconciliation must use multiset overlap within each semantic course-type role, never an observation-index or campus join.
reconstruction.separation_from_live_archive: This reviewed paper-rule artifact is distinct from the website's live archived-requirement reconstruction, whose generic typed-requirement heuristic is retained only as a separate sensitivity.
reconstruction.separation_from_summary_tabs: The companion notebook's hard-coded plotting arrays and other typed summary cells are not inputs to these values.
